name: Claude Design System (artifact type)
what: One browsable brand reference that agents read and build on: a brand-book README, tokens.json (color across themes, type, spacing, radius and more), components with previews and guidelines, assets, fonts and a cover. Design canvases, Slides decks and Data dashboards install or read it.
install: No install line. Artifacts and the Design System template must be on for the claude.ai account; on Team and Enterprise an organization Owner enables them in organization settings. In Claude Code, sign in with /login and a claude.ai account.
firstCall: Artifact list with type 'Design System' to find an existing system; to create one, Artifact quickstart with intent 'other' when the host offers it, else an Artifact types list, then read the type's SKILL.md that the create call returns
evidenceNote: Artifact read calls on the type's SKILL.md, format, craft, cover, from-code and from-design-tool files succeeded. Five existing systems were read live (file listing, README, tokens or token stylesheets, index) and the copies matched the listed hashes, so reading a system by path is verified. NOT exercised: creating a system, writing tokens, a clean-up, a code sync, an install into a canvas or deck. The label stays DOCUMENTED because the type's main function, building a system, did not run. With no artifacts in the session the fallback is the local brand pack built by the design-system skill, which has no catalog id.
